# `Q-24-13` — The Converter Failed on This File

> The converter ran out of memory or time, or crashed, on this file.

## What this means

The converter was stopped before it finished. The hint says whether it ran out of memory, took too long, or crashed.

## Why this happens

- The document is large or has very many images.
- The file is damaged in a way that crashes the reader.

## How to fix

Import a smaller copy, or open the file in its own application and save a fresh copy.
